contracts.sha256_file: sha256_file(path) reads ordinary binary files up to 1048576 bytes without changing them. Return path relative to the workspace, bytes, and sha256 as lowercase hexadecimal. Reject larger files, missing files, directories and escaping paths.
contracts.csv_preview: csv_preview(path, limit=5) reads UTF-8 CSV of at most 100000 Unicode characters using Python csv.reader. Return path relative to the workspace, rows (a list of lists of strings, at most limit records), and truncated (whether additional records exist). Do not treat the first row as a special header. Preserve quoted commas, Unicode and CRLF inside quoted fields. Empty input has no rows. limit must be an integer from 1 to 20, excluding bool. Reject invalid UTF-8, oversized input, missing files, directories and escaping paths. Preserve every input byte.
contracts.format_json: format_json(path) reads UTF-8 JSON of at most 100000 Unicode characters using Python json.loads. Replace it with json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, indent=2) followed by one LF newline. Return path relative to the workspace and bytes of the final UTF-8 file. The formatted output must also fit 100000 Unicode characters. Reject invalid JSON, invalid UTF-8, oversized input or output, missing files, directories and escaping paths before changing any bytes.

protocol.recipe: Read harness/README.md and relevant source. Implement and register exactly the requested capability. Change runtime code only in harness/autoproteus/tools.py and harness/autoproteus/providers.py. Preserve the loop and every existing test file exactly; add a separate focused tests/test_*.py file. Use the shared helpers where appropriate. Generate large test data with short expressions. Run python3 harness/seed.py check and exercise the edited tool on disposable inputs. Repair actual failures. Finish completed only after implementing and verifying the feature. There is no network or package installation. No separate report is required.

function.name: list_files
function.description: List a directory in the task workspace; path defaults to '.'.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a complete UTF-8 file of at most 12000 characters. Larger files require read_section; never returns a partial file.

function.name: read_section
function.description: Read a relevant section of a UTF-8 file. start is a character position (default 0), length is characters (default 1000, maximum 12000). Prefer useful sections to many tiny reads. next_start continues a whole-file read when needed; stop once you have enough context.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Create or replace a text file. Supply its complete content.

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace old_text exactly once in a UTF-8 file, preserving surrounding text. Use a small unique fragment from the current source. Missing or ambiguous matches return locations to inspect; never guess or rewrite the whole file to repair a match.

function.name: delete_file
function.description: Delete one ordinary workspace file. Directories and links are rejected.

function.name: search_files
function.description: Find literal text in UTF-8 workspace files. Returns paths, line numbers, character start offsets for read_section, and short snippets. Bounded search; narrow the path if incomplete.

function.name: finish
function.description: Report verified completion, or ask the user for required information.

function.name: run_command
function.description: Run a native shell command from the task workspace.

protocol.invoke_tool:
"""Opt-in development invocation. Run only inside the guest, never on the host."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys


def main():
    sys.path.insert(0, str(Path('harness').resolve()))
    from autoproteus.providers import tool_definitions
    from autoproteus.tools import Workspace
    tool, arguments = sys.argv[1], json.loads(sys.argv[2])
    definitions = {entry['function']['name']: entry['function'] for entry in tool_definitions(False)}
    if tool == 'finish' or tool not in definitions or not isinstance(arguments, dict):
        raise ValueError('Use a registered workspace tool and a JSON argument object')
    if any(key not in arguments for key in definitions[tool]['parameters']['required']):
        raise ValueError('Missing required tool arguments')
    result = Workspace(Path.cwd()).execute(tool, arguments)
    print(json.dumps({'check': 'development tool invocation', 'passed': True, 'tool': tool, 'result': result}, ensure_ascii=True))
    print('Invocation only. Read the resulting file and compare exact expected contents; run the full suite separately.')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
